candidates.title: 카프카 트랜잭션
candidates.concept_granularity: single feature added to make stream processing correct, giving atomic writes across several partitions and fencing zombie producers so each input record is processed and reflected exactly once

candidates.title: 읽기-처리-쓰기 패턴
candidates.concept_granularity: single stream processing shape - read from a topic, process, write to another - which is the pattern transactions were built to make correct

candidates.title: 트랜잭션이 필요한 처리
candidates.concept_granularity: single selection rule: per-record transforms and filters can shrug off duplicates, while aggregation and joins cannot, because a wrong aggregate is hard to spot and unfixable without reprocessing the input

candidates.title: 크래시로 인한 재처리
aliases: 결과 write 후 오프셋 커밋 전 크래시
candidates.concept_granularity: single duplication path in which the application writes its result and crashes before committing the offset, so the partition's next owner reprocesses everything since the last commit and writes the results again

candidates.title: 좀비 애플리케이션
candidates.concept_granularity: single instance that stalled long enough to be declared dead and have its partitions reassigned, then resumes and keeps writing results and heartbeating until it learns it was evicted

candidates.title: 원자적 다수 파티션 쓰기
candidates.concept_granularity: single mechanism exploiting the fact that both the offset commit and the result write are partition writes, so one transaction covers the output topic and _consumer_offsets together and either both land or neither does

candidates.title: transactional.id
candidates.concept_granularity: single producer-configured identifier that survives restarts, which the broker maps to a producer id so a reinitialized producer gets its previous one back rather than a fresh random value

candidates.title: 좀비 펜싱
candidates.concept_granularity: single exclusion mechanism bumping an epoch per transactional id on initialization, after which any producer holding the same id at a lower epoch has its sends, commits and aborts rejected and can only close

candidates.title: 컨슈머 그룹 메타데이터 펜싱
candidates.concept_granularity: single option from Kafka 2.5.0 adding consumer group metadata to the transaction's own metadata, letting fencing work while producers with different transactional ids write to the same partitions

candidates.title: 트랜잭션은 프로듀서 쪽 기능
candidates.concept_granularity: single placement fact that creating the transactional producer, beginning, writing records and offsets, and committing or aborting all happen on the producer

candidates.title: isolation.level
candidates.concept_granularity: single consumer setting deciding whether polls return only committed and non-transactional messages or every record including aborted and in-flight ones, without which transactional writes give no exactly-once guarantee on the read side

candidates.title: Last Stable Offset
candidates.concept_granularity: single read barrier under read_committed at the start of the oldest open transaction, holding later messages back until that transaction commits, aborts, or times out, which lengthens end-to-end delay while it stays open

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 없이 쓰여진 입력
aliases: 출력 커밋이 입력 오프셋 커밋을 보장
candidates.concept_granularity: single guarantee that exactly-once output holds even when the input topic was written without transactions, because committing the output also commits the input offset
